as_told.title: Levenda: DeLonge pointed to the Prometheus myth

plain: Around 2015, one of the musician Tom DeLonge's most trusted advisers is said to have sent a long email asking, "how much do you know about Greek mythology?", a hint that the answer to the UFO question might lie in old myths like the story of Prometheus. The writer Peter Levenda, who worked with DeLonge, tells Michels about it and says the email was sent to "us". Michels tells it more loosely, from Levenda: people close to these rocket launches pushed DeLonge to study Greek mythology. He does not mention an email.
